label: Development test set. Synthetic passages for retrieval engineering. Not a legal benchmark and not a source of law.

passages.text: On 1 March the seller made a written offer to sell a refurbished espresso machine for 4800.
On 3 March the buyer sent a written acceptance of the offer to purchase the espresso machine.
The price of 4800 was the consideration for the sale of the espresso machine.
The demonstration court awards 900 as the cost of hiring a temporary espresso machine after late delivery.
The cafe opens to the public from seven in the morning until four in the afternoon.
Section 2-204 of the synthetic commerce code says a contract for sale may be made in any manner sufficient to show agreement.
Section 2-209 of the synthetic chapter says a modification needs no consideration to be binding in this demonstration text.
The archive room stores paper clips, boxes, and a spare ladder. It says nothing about contracts or sentencing.

queries.text: What was the consideration for the espresso machine?
When was the written acceptance sent?
What amount was awarded for the temporary machine?
How may a contract for sale be made under section 2-204?
What are the cafe opening hours?
